title: File:Iodine treatment apparatus for tuberculosis, France,1830-187 Wellcome L0066065.jpg
desc: Physicians experimented with iodine to treat tuberculosis during the 1800s. This is a dangerous infectious disease that usually attacks the lungs. This iodine treatment apparatus was developed in France by Dr Chartroule. The medication was placed in the glass vial and inhaled via the long ivory mout
